title: Backend Engineer (SDE-2), Payments
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Backend Engineer (SDE-2) to build payment and order services.
What you will do
- Design and build REST APIs and microservices in Java and Spring Boot
- Own PostgreSQL schemas, Flyway migrations and Redis caching
- Run services on Docker with CI in GitHub Actions
Requirements
- 2-4 years of experience in backend development with Java
- Strong knowledge of Spring Boot, JPA/Hibernate, REST, SQL
- Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS
Benefits
- Health insurance, flexible hours
